cards.problem: Use non-differentiable real navigation rewards to update the original Flow policy with an explicitly defined surrogate ratio.
actual_contents: Selected PyTorch path uses x_t=(1-t)*eps+t*a, t uniform and eps Gaussian; sampled rollout action is detached.
Fresh CFM noise is independent from rollout noise, but the exact saved CFM noise/time is shared by old/current loss.
CFM error is mean over action coordinates. Paper Eq8 is squared L2 sum; these differ by raw action dimension in log-ratio.
Each MC old-minus-current loss difference is clamped[-3,3], then MC averaged, clamped and exponentiated.
PPO-style min of unclipped/clipped advantage objective is averaged over actions.
Upstream GridWorld defaults MC50, ratio clip0.2. MC count is not our rollout candidate group count.
JAX directories have other interpolation/ratio variants; do not silently combine them.
Uniform OT velocity MSE must not receive the epsilon-space time weight again.
reusable: Explicit per-action MC losses and clipping
new_adaptation: Contextual-bandit group-centered advantages instead of GridWorld GAE
Original VLA BC anchor with unchanged Beta-derived time sampler
Navigation full trajectory action representation and true reward context

Explicit dropout mode/coupling contract for DiT
